scripts.build:extensions: npm run build -w devora-code-core && npm run build -w devora-code-jira
scripts.build:all: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:api && npm run build:webview && npm run build:extensions
scripts.watch:all: concurrently --kill-others -n "core,jira,webview,api,sdk" -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow,cyan" "npm run watch -w devora-code-core" "npm run watch -w devora-code-jira" "npm run watch --prefix devora-code-webview" "npm run watch --prefix devora-code-api" "npm run watch --prefix devora-code-sdk"
